answer.rationale: The p99 write latency spike began 90 minutes after the release deployment, indicating a strong causal link to the new build. memory_b1 demonstrates that rolling back a problematic release resolved a similar checkout error spike without customer impact, directly supporting sustained availability and write preservation. Alternative interventions (failover, capacity addition, circuit breakers) do not address the likely root cause as effectively, and read-replica routing does not mitigate write-path latency. Given peak settlement traffic, immediate rollback maximizes the probability of restoring normal latency while preserving all customer writes.
